subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should the CI dependency-verification bypass remain bundled with this Signal bug fix, based on confirmation that `setup-node-env` validates dependencies for every additional-boundary shard invocation?
rationale: The Signal fix is narrow, but the same branch changes the failure-detection boundary for parallel CI commands; source-level patch context alone does not establish the intended workflow contract.

options.title: Split the CI mitigation
options.body: Merge or review the Signal newline fix independently and move the pnpm verification change into a dedicated CI PR with runner-contract evidence.

options.title: Keep the combined branch
options.body: Accept the combined PR after confirming the setup job validates dependencies before every affected boundary command and the CI mitigation is intentionally coupled to this validation run.

options.title: Pause the CI change
options.body: Remove the workflow change if the dependency-validation ownership cannot be established without weakening CI safeguards.

recommendation.title: Split the CI mitigation
recommendation.body: Merge or review the Signal newline fix independently and move the pnpm verification change into a dedicated CI PR with runner-contract evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both changed surfaces and are the assigned recent contributor; repository-owner history could not be established from the available read-only evidence.
